pl-l4d1c8-d1e115.summary: Asks what remedy against sin was available to men who lived before circumcision and to women before and after it.

pl-l4d1c8-d1e118.summary: Reports that some say sacrifices and offerings availed for the remission of sin. Lombard says it is better to hold that Abraham's descendants were justified by circumcision; women by faith and good works, their own if adults or their parents' if children; children before circumcision by their parents' faith; and the parents by the power of sacrifices, which they understood spiritually.
claims: Abraham's descendants were justified by circumcision.
Women were justified by faith and good works.
Before circumcision children were justified by their parents' faith, adults by sacrifices spiritually understood.

pl-l4d1c8-d1e124.summary: Quotes Gregory: what the water of baptism does for us, faith alone did for children among the ancients, the power of sacrifice for adults, and the mystery of circumcision for those of Abraham's stock.
claims: Before baptism, faith, sacrifice, and circumcision served as remedies for sin.

pl-l4d1c8.summary: Asks what remedy against sin was available to men before circumcision and to women before and after. Some say sacrifices and offerings remitted sin. Lombard thinks it better to say that Abraham's descendants were justified by circumcision; women by faith and good works, their own if adults or their parents' if children; children before circumcision by their parents' faith; and the parents by the power of sacrifices, understood spiritually. Gregory confirms: what baptismal water does for us, faith alone did for children, the power of sacrifice for adults, and circumcision for Abraham's line.
claims: Abraham's descendants were justified by circumcision.
Women were justified by faith and good works, their own or their parents'.
Before circumcision children were saved by their parents' faith, adults by the power of sacrifices spiritually understood.
